spec_match.rationale: Exercises the options bag exactly as proposed: mode shortest/longest/strict with per-source padding array read only in longest mode; rationale text cites the design-space decisions (closing shorter sources, first-error-wins).

interactive.rationale: Radio mode selection plus run; each mode performs the real call and the strict path genuinely throws.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises three real policies over fixed mismatched inputs; delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: The whole page is the length-mismatch edge; strict's throw is displayed as the engine's real error, and null padding demonstrates unnamed fills.

conformance.rationale: Suite's shortest/longest/strict assertions encode these exact three runs.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP run: strict mode selected and run — genuine TypeError shown with the mode rationale; zero console errors; 0px overflow both classes; screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: zip-strict-threw asserts the throw happens only in strict mode on supporting engines; honest-unsupported branch recorded otherwise.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; error text accent-rose on paper (AA).

accessibility.rationale: Fieldset/legend radio group; aria-live result with a textual rationale line.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Inline choices wrap; 0px overflow at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×2000.

openQuestions.title: Record strict mode's exact error type on a supporting engine
openQuestions.detail: The proposal README doesn't pin the strict-mismatch error class; the suite accepts any throw. On Chrome 153 with the flag, record the actual error name and tighten the page copy if stable.

guidanceConsulted.query: radio group drives live outcome region
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Fieldset-grouped radios with an announced outcome.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Mode radios in a fieldset; result panel aria-live with per-mode rationale text.

guidanceConsulted.query: inline radio row wrapping small screens
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Allow choice chips to wrap rather than fixing a row.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Choices are inline-flex with margins that wrap; verified 0px overflow at 360px.

summary: Verified headlessly (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): mode switching and the real call per mode confirmed on Chromium 141 (honest TypeError for all three, correct rationale text), console clean at both viewports.
